title: Stop translating the particle le as past tense
summary: Treat 了 le as completion or a new situation, and let time words carry the past.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: Thinking of 了 le as a past tense ending produces sentences that no one says. Mandarin locates events with time words such as 昨天 zuótiān (yesterday) and marks the shape of a situation with 了 le. Ask two separate questions whenever you want one: is this action reported as done, and is anything changing now? 我买了票 wǒ mǎi le piào (I bought the tickets) answers the first; 下雨了 xià yǔ le (it has started to rain) and 我不喝茶了 wǒ bù hē chá le (I do not drink tea any more) answer the second. When you are unsure, say the sentence without 了 le and check whether a listener still understands you; they usually do, which tells you 了 le was decoration.
